suggestions.assertion: Only README.md and src/format.ts changed (objective: only_readme_and_format_changed)
suggestions.reason: This check and the title/typo checks verify which files changed and the final text, but nothing checks that the diff is confined to the two necessary lines. An agent that reformatted or rewrote large portions of README.md and src/format.ts while still landing on the correct title and spelling would still pass every current expectation. In this run the diff was minimal (2 files changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-), confirmed via outputs/diff.txt), but the eval doesn't structurally guard against a noisier, harder-to-review diff passing just as well.

eval_feedback.overall: Solid, well-targeted eval for a cosmetic-edit task -- the expectations correctly discriminate between doing the two requested edits cleanly versus overreaching (subagents, extra files, broken tests) or under-claiming (fabricated test-writing). The one gap is that no assertion checks diff minimality/scope beyond file-level granularity.
